name: TimeScribe
description:
Modern & private time tracking for macOS & Windows. No cloud, no registration, no paywall. Just download and track your work hours 100% offline.

TimeScribe runs locally on your device, needs no account, and helps you keep track of your working hours, breaks, projects and overtime.

TimeScribe is completely free. There are no hidden costs, no subscriptions, and no restrictions.

Features:
	• Document working hours
	For home office, office, and flexible work models. Keep working hours and breaks clearly and reliably 	recorded.

	• Understand overtime
	See early when you are working too much or too little. That helps you spot deviations before they add up.
	
	•Bill client hours
	Track projects, hourly rates, and exports for invoices. That helps you document billable time cleanly and without 	much rework.

	•Right from the menu bar
	Control your timer directly from the menu bar and switch quickly between projects. That keeps your time tracking 	only one click away

	• App tracking
	TimeScribe shows you which apps you used during your workday. That gives you more overview and helps you 	understand your time better.

	• Absences & holidays
	Plan vacation and manage sick days clearly in one place. Public holidays can also be considered automatically in 	your calendar and time tracking.

	• Keyboard shortcuts & deeplinks
	Start and control TimeScribe via shortcut or deeplink without clicking through the app. Ideal for fast workflows and 	your own automations.
